youtube_description:
Part 2/2 - Former Deputy British PM, John Prescott, speaks to Tony Jones on Lateline about the latest revelations from the News of the World Phone hacking scandal.

He expresses great concern about Rupert Murdoch's plan to takeover BSkyB and closes the interview by saying "Watch him in Australia as well."

Lateline -- ABC1
Broadcast: 6 July 2011 22:30 AEST
Australian Broadcasting Corporation
